newsitem.title: GERMANY: Allianz names alternative risk unit.
newsitem.headline: Allianz names alternative risk unit.

text.p: The newly established risk transfer unit of Allianz AG will be called "Allianz Risk Transfer", Allianz chairman Henning Schulte-Noelle said.
The company will have share capital of 500 million Swiss francs, Schulte-Noelle said at the annual shareholders' meeting in Thursday.
The name was chosen in direct reference to the abbreviation for Alternative Risk Transfer or ART, he said.
The company, which was set up with its main location in Zurich a few weeks ago, will officially start operating in the autumn, Allianz spokesman Emilio Galli-Zugaro told Reuters.

Allianz sees the ART business within the group as an additional service to its industrial clients, Galli-Zugaro said. Products will include risk transfer for financial and foreign exchange risks as well as catastrophe bonds.
The company was in the process of hiring staff. Units of Allianz Risk Transfer were planned in Amsterdam and in the U.S.
Schulte-Noelle said the market in the area of alternative risk transfer was growing fast with an estimated market volume of more than $30 billion.
